steps.caption: AI drafts and style
steps.narration: AI drafts write captions and posts in your own voice. Here is where that voice is set.

steps.value: Announce fall gutter clean-outs. Name the Denver neighborhoods we serve. End with a call to book a free inspection.
steps.caption: Instructions
steps.narration: Instructions tell the AI what this post or caption is about.

steps.value: Crew finishing a tear-off on a ranch home in Wheat Ridge. Done in one day, yard cleaned up.
steps.caption: Example descriptions
steps.narration: Example descriptions show it the wording you like.

steps.caption: Generate caption drafts
steps.narration: Generate caption drafts writes one caption per ticked photo, so it needs a photo ticked first.

steps.caption: Generate post draft
steps.narration: Generate post draft puts a draft in the Post draft box below, ready to edit.

steps.caption: Style guidance
steps.narration: Style guidance is the voice every draft follows. This listing's notes are already saved.

steps.caption: Learn from past updates
steps.narration: Learn from past updates reads the posts already on the Google listing and suggests notes.

steps.value: Friendly, plain-spoken and local. Lead with the homeowner benefit, name the Denver neighborhood when we know it, keep posts under 120 words, one clear call to action. No hype, no prices.
steps.caption: Edit the notes
steps.narration: Edit the notes in your own words.

steps.caption: Save style guidance
steps.narration: They count as a draft until you choose Save style guidance.

steps.caption: Post draft
steps.narration: A generated post lands in the Post draft box, where you can change any word.

steps.narration: And AI text remains a draft until you approve it.
